question: A. Despite of B. his low score in the test, C. he was able to pass D. the course.

options.text: his low score in the test

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Despite .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Despite of"** is grammatically incorrect. The correct usage is simply **"Despite"**.
 
• **"Despite"** is a preposition that does not require the addition of "of" to indicate contrast or opposition.
 
• In the given sentence, the word **"Despite"** should be used to introduce the contrast between the low score in the test and the ability to pass the course.

Correct sentence: *Despite his low score in the test, he was able to pass the course.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common Usage of "Despite":**
 
 
• **Correct:** Despite the rain, they went for a walk.
 
• **Incorrect:** Despite of the rain, they went for a walk.
 
 
 
• **Other Words for Contrast:**
 
 
• **Although:** Although he was tired, he finished his work.
 
• **However:** He wanted to go out; however, it was too late.
